k.code:
authorised = false
if authorised then
    print("Access granted")
else
    print("Access denied")
endif
p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Explain the difference between authorised access and unauthorised access under the Computer Misuse Act 1990.
k.a: With authorised=false: Access denied. Changing it to true prints Access granted. The Computer Misuse Act 1990 addresses unauthorised access; a user having a password does not automatically mean they have permission for every system or file. This Boolean is only a teaching model.

mastery.task: Design a permissions check that allows a user to read but not necessarily write a file. Test authorised role, action and account status.
mastery.hint: Use roles/permissions, not only password knowledge.
mastery.answer: A reader requesting read -> Allowed; reader requesting write -> Denied; inactive user -> Denied regardless of role.
